---
title: Budget and Revenue
---

Do bigger budget films earn more money? @fig-budget-revenue plots the production budget of a film against its revenue

::: {#6a2ae5b4 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget(USD)")
plt.show
```
